what_changed:
• Fixed Linux video playback freeze: use GStreamer instead of FFmpeg (FFmpeg blocked the UI while probing Immich HTTP streams).
• Video player and hover preview render via QVideoSink software frames instead of QVideoWidget, avoiding EGL_BAD_CONTEXT / missing DRI2 on Wayland/XWayland.
• Re-enabled GStreamer hover video preview on native Linux (still disabled under Snap).
